reviews.text: The staff were super friendly. We visited for grooming and also bought some pet products. It was the best haircut for our dog Jasmine, very thorough and cleanly done. Overall, an excellent experience.

I had been coming here regularly for about two years to have my cat groomed. However, on this particular occasion, they hadn’t recorded my appointment, which meant that my day off work (at my new job) had been completely wasted.

Naturally, I was extremely frustrated and angry, especially as my cat was very matted due to having fine fur. I asked if they could offer some kind of compensation for the inconvenience, perhaps a complimentary grooming session.

When the owner called me back, however, she was immediately defensive and essentially accused me of lying. I was shocked, as I had booked the appointment with her personally a month earlier. She didn’t even apologise for the mix-up and instead basically told me never to come back.

I felt completely belittled and unvalued as a customer. She was right about one thing, I would never go back there again!

What an incredibly unprofessional way to deal with a customer, with absolutely no sense of customer service. A truly horrible experience!

Another fabulous grooming session for Coco & Geva from Stephen. Because of the heat we decided to take their coats a bit shorter than usual without losing their feathers. Stephen did a marvellous job. Coco (Chanel) got a lovely bob style round her ears which really suits her. Geva kept the feathery look. They love their new looks. Thank you to all at Pet Pavilion Primose Hill.

Thank you for such a wonderful grooming experience. Zyggi looks absolutely beautiful and was clearly very well cared for. It's always reassuring to leave your dog with someone you trust, and the attention to detail really shows. We couldn't be happier with the result!

Unfortunately another bad review. Simply because we got our grooming appointment cancelled 30 minutes before the booked time. With London traffic we of course were already on the way, actually by the Pavilion. We booked weeks in advance as we wanted to have a fresh cut before the beach vacation and unfortunately we couldn’t find any available spot that morning at any other grooming salons.
please change the name to dog pavillion
Great shop and a lovely efficient groomer. Marta did exactly what I wanted. I will be going back for sure

Stella Groom for our little pup!

Listened to the brief and knocked it out of the park!

❤️
Very pet owner-centric store, with loads of product choices. The groomers  always leaves my canine friend looking smart and very happy.
Super store, one stop shop for canines. Diane —the manager — was charming and knowledgeable. I’m very pleased with my new lead!

Really friendly service as always and a very smart looking pooch after his MOT. Also, the teeth cleaning service is great - really recommended and I think will prove to be good value in the long run, as dog dental health can be a challenge! Very happy customer.
Very friendly and excellent grooming.
Always the best service, smiley happy dogs and staff, and full of support for local events. Top dog so to speak 😜 thank you always team x Tracy and Phoebe …

The groomer at Pet Pavillion does a lovely job with our Australian Labradoodle Teddy. The groomer is kind, asks the right questions and is very professional. The other members of the team are also very friendly and efficient. I am lucky to have this service in my neighbourhood.

The staff at Pet Pavillion are the absolute best. It’s clear they adore our pups and running this shop on our high street.  Adore them. The location is well stocked and managed and grooming services are fantastic.

So lucky to live local to Pet Pavillion, the best range of treats, toys food, collars & leads. They literally have it all! And ALWAYS greet us with a smile and friendly chat. Makes a big difference to our day. Support local! This place is fab! (Photo attached the coat and collar is from here!)

I love this little shop. Diane is my favourite. They’re very lucky to have her (give her a raise!!) it’s like she owns the shop, that’s how great she is with customers. And I also love that I can get my raw dog food here. So easy. See you soon !
Great pet store who have a wide range of quality foods for my dogs. Diane and Nicole are extremely helpful and lovely and always make shopping experience a joy!
Lovely staff and Steven is an exceptional and patient groomer who is deeply intuitive!
Absolutely love it here! The staff are very friendly and helpful my frenchie loves it.

I was particularly blown away by the customer service. I visited this shop to buy some treats and food for my dog. I was attended by Nicole. The staff was very knowledgeable. My indecisiveness unfortunately meant to spend a lot of time on the shop but not once was I made to feel like I was overstaying. My dog loved the treats and food suggested by the staff. Thank you for your patience and kind attitude.

Good Morning, I just want to say thank you to all the staff for the good service. I've been a couple of times with my little dog Keira for grooming and treats and the young lady and blonde at the front desk are very welcoming and helpful. Keira is well cared for because she leaves happy.
My dog always pulls me in here! Lovely little shop, great selection and the ladies here are always very nice. Thanks, we’ll be back again!
Was pleasantly surprised they open on a Sunday. Got everything I needed for a warm day in the park, friendly service too!

I shop at Pet Pavillion in Primrose Hill on a near-weekly basis; purely out of convenience to pick up fresh small-sized tennis balls for my dog for the park (he tends to destroy them quite easily).
I have never met 2 more miserable people working with animals than the blond older woman and the younger brunette woman with glasses. They never say hello, to me let alone my dog (or my baby when he joins us), they have never cracked a smile, they don't offer any help unless I ask for it myself and even then it seems painstaking - for the life of me I cannot understand why you would work front of house in a pet store if you seem to neither like humans nor pets. Always leaves me with such an ick and wishing for a local alternative.
